body: a retro-future neighborhood-watch mecha-dog mount, full clean side-profile reference view, standing on all four legs facing left, legs clearly separated and fully visible, a simple flat saddle-pad on its back (empty, no rider), a friendly alert-eared head with one small satellite-dish-style antenna, a wagging tail rendered mid-motion as a slight blur. Picket-fence white #e8e4da body plating, muted lawn-green #7a9c6a panel trim (deliberately less saturated than other realms -- this is the gently mundane realm), a single warm porch-light-orange #ffb85c glowing collar-tag as the only accent light. TURTLE'S NOTE: this should look like a friendly household appliance that happens to be dog-shaped, not a war machine -- rounded panel corners, no sharp edges, the overall feel of a very good robot vacuum that grew legs. Cinematic occult-almanac quality render but gentle/bright not dark, soft midday suburban daylight, plain flat pale background so the silhouette reads clearly, full body visible nose to tail, no text, no logos, no rider, no watermark
